system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Metal Detecting Hobbyists (Détectoristes / Poêleurs)
proposals.buyer_persona: Amateur treasure hunters who spend weekends in French fields looking for historical coins and military relics, highly proud of their 'trouvailles' and sharing them on specialized forums.
product_angles: A pocket-sized 'Finds Logbook' (KDP) with dedicated tables for GPS coordinates, depth, metal type, and patina status
Humorous detectorist quote stickers for car bumpers or equipment cases ('Bip Bip... Capsule de bière!')
Vector SVG packs of vintage French coins and historical coat of arms for custom gear engraving
proposals.first_test_product: KDP Pocket Finds Logbook (Carnet de Détection de Métaux)

proposals.name: Histotechnology & Pathology Lab Technicians
proposals.buyer_persona: Medical laboratory professionals who prepare micro-slices of human tissue on glass slides. They love dark humor, microscopy aesthetics (H&E pink/blue staining), and feel ignored by mainstream medical merch.
product_angles: Microscope slide pattern stickers and aesthetic phone wallpapers
Tissue microtome calibration logs and laboratory notebook templates (KDP)
Histology coloring pages featuring beautiful cellular structures under the microscope
proposals.first_test_product: H&E stained cell pattern sticker pack on Redbubble

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA / AMHE) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: Adult martial artists who study medieval combat manuals (Fechtbücher) to fight with longswords, bucklers, and rapiers. High disposable income, academic mindset, obsessed with historic authenticity.
product_angles: Cleaned vector restoration packs of 15th-century fencing manual illustrations (Talhoffer, Lichtenauer) for apparel printing
HEMA sparring and technique training journal (KDP)
Waterproof stickers with insider combat theory memes (e.g., 'Master Cuts' diagrams)
proposals.first_test_product: HEMA Combat Training Logbook on KDP

proposals.name: Godot Engine Indie Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie developers migrating from Unity to Godot who need rapid prototyping assets and UI setups. They work solo and are highly budget-conscious but will buy time-saving modular UI templates.
product_angles: Modular Flat Vector UI kits optimized and pre-sliced for Godot's Control nodes
Godot-specific UI Theme preset files (.tres) with modern dark/light styling
Icon packs for game settings, inputs (keyboard/gamepad), and inventory management
proposals.first_test_product: Flat Vector Game UI & Input Icon Pack for Godot (itch.io & Cults3D)

proposals.name: Mushroom Foragers & Mycology Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Wild food foragers and home mushroom growers (gourmet/medicinal) who obsess over spore prints, mycelium growth phases, and forest navigation.
product_angles: Spore Print Collection Journals (KDP) with specialized dark/light collection pages
Vintage scientific/botanical style mushroom identification vector sticker sheets
Mushroom cultivator logbooks for tracking liquid culture and substrate recipes

proposals.name: Local French 'Amicales des Sapeurs-Pompiers' (Volunteer Firefighters)
proposals.buyer_persona: Volunteer firefighters in French municipalities responsible for creating and selling their annual local calendars and merchandise to raise funds for their 'Amicale'.
product_angles: Customizable local fire station calendar templates (digital PDF/InDesign templates sold via B2B outreach)
Vector design bundles for localized firefighter t-shirts ('Sapeurs-Pompiers de [Nom_Commune]')
Retirement and end-of-service custom certificate templates
proposals.first_test_product: Editable Firefighter Calendar Template Pack (Etsy/Direct Mail)
